ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: the Rust Cathedral
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
RUSTCATHEDRAL_RM_MOD_BUILD_1 (Phase A row 12 of design/RimMandrake/biome_mod_architecture.md; parent BIOME_MOD_SPLIT_EXECUTION_1). A flat mechanoid-garrisoned plateau of deck plate and mathematical walls at the foot of an eternal noon, almost lifeless, and under everything, always, a hum. Fully generalized: it names no other franchise or campaign. A separate frozen campaign world's own Rust Cathedral instance (RUT_RustCathedral, src/RimUtinni/UtinniPatches) is unaffected and unrelated; this is a new sibling biome for everyone else's worlds, not a rename of that one.
RM tier: nothing here knows what campaign or planet uses it.
ABSORBS two former standalone satellite kits that were filed at the wrong tier (RUST_CATHEDRAL_MECHANICS_1's own §3c): mandrake.rut.rustcathedralhum (the hum-mood attitude system, living bolts, coolant-eel fishing consequences, the deep-drill response) and mandrake.rut.rustcathedralwalls (the four-tier wall economy: deck plate, dead smartsteel, one sacred wall variant, live pattern metal). Both keep their own two DLLs, namespaces and settings DATA classes completely unchanged (assembly-merge trade, option (b): zero namespace churn, zero XML class-binding edits) — only their standalone Mod-derived settings wrappers are retired in favor of one screen here. mandrake.rut.rustcathedralroaches (the third kit, the land-cleaning roaches) is NOT absorbed: its cathedral roach is DUPLICATED into this mod as RM_CathedralRoach (own defName, own art copy, a first-ever Mod Settings toggle) while the original RUT_CathedralRoach stays exactly where it is, still serving the frozen campaign twin until Phase B; that kit's other creature (RUT_ScarRoach, a Scarlands sibling with no connection to this biome) is untouched and unaffected — left for a future Scarlands mod build to decide, per that item's own "do not silently absorb it" caution.
Ships the biome and its own placement worker (RM_BiomeWorker_RustCathedral, replacing the donor AlphaBiomes.BiomeWorker_MechanoidIntrusion — a donor type in workerClass is a hard dependency the RimMandrake tier may not assume) plus its own two floor TerrainDefs (RM_RustCathedral_CrackedMetalSoil, RM_RustCathedral_PolymerFloor — own defNames, no donor ParentName chain).
⚠️ Not texture-free: those two TerrainDefs and the biome's own world-map icon still point at Alpha Biomes' own pixels (no art pipeline pass has run for this biome's floor yet), so sarg.alphabiomes ships as a hard modDependency rather than an optional MayRequire — same disclosed trade RM_Miasma makes for its own flora textures. A future pass can generate this mod's own art and drop the dependency; nothing here blocks that.
The absorbed kit's fishing consequences (RUT_CoolantEel, the sole entry in this biome's fishTypes) and wall-tier scatter (forceRockTypes plus two GenSteps added to the shared MapCommonBase) are now NATIVE fields/content on this mod's own RM_RustCathedral def, dissolved from the two self-patches the satellite kits used to carry onto the frozen twin (a self-patch is pointless once the def is owned outright). RUT_CoolantEel is Odyssey-only by construction (ParentName="FishBase" MayRequire="Ludeon.RimWorld.Odyssey"), so Odyssey ships as a hard dependency too — per the owner's 2026-09-25 standing design ruling ("always assume all the DLCs"), every RimMandrake biome mod may assume the full expansion set is present.
wildAnimals: RM_CathedralRoach 0.12 (own, cleaner), GR_Mecharat 0.5 (donor mech-vermin, ruled — stays inline per Q11a: not Star Wars fauna, no Utinni patch owed), RUT_LivingBolt 0.06 (the hum's own display organ, wired here for the first time — the frozen twin's own copy never wired one, so the kit's §3 could never spawn). Ling_Cockroach is DROPPED — the roster's own 2026-09-07 owner addendum supersedes the frozen twin's earlier reading that kept it. wildPlants stays EMPTY — RULED zero (frozen sheet hard ban 7: "green flora count: zero"), not a gap.
Mod Settings: a worldgen-rarity slider (0 = never generates); the absorbed Hum kit's own screen (hum-mood, commentary, goodwill drain, bolt dance/shed/pricing, fishing pricing, drill response — all pre-existing, unchanged); the absorbed Walls kit's own screen (wall tiers, sacred wall chance, live-pattern-metal gate — pre-existing, unchanged); and this mod's own new roach-cleaning toggle (the roach's cleaning behavior never had one before) plus a cross-biome section honestly disclosed as reserved and not yet wired to any mechanic.
Live proof (a scratch-world quicktest with all five expansions, minimal list + this mod + mandrake.rm.creaturebehaviors, legacy kits DISABLED to avoid duplicate-defName collisions) is Desktop-only and OWED — see the item's own verify record. This is the first-ever live load of any of the six kit sections this mod carries.
